description: Android activity class implementing an auto-complete text view with contact suggestions, including a custom CursorAdapter.

classes.name: AutoComplete4
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up an AutoCompleteTextView with contact suggestions.

classes.name: ContactListAdapter
classes.description: Custom CursorAdapter implementing Filterable to provide contact suggestions for the AutoCompleteTextView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, queries contacts, and sets up the adapter for the AutoCompleteTextView.

methods.name: newView
methods.description: Creates a new view for each item in the dropdown list, inflating a simple dropdown item layout.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds data from cursor to the view, setting the display name.

methods.name: convertToString
methods.description: Converts a cursor row to a string for display in the AutoCompleteTextView.

methods.name: runQueryOnBackgroundThread
methods.description: Performs a contact query based on the user's input, supporting filtering.
